title: Figures 18-19: FDL-7C/D and Model 176 entry temperatures; Mach 12 phosphor image
description: Figure 18 shows plan and side-view outline drawings of a hypersonic glider annotated with radiation-equilibrium skin temperatures from 800 °F to 6,400 °F (e.g., "*4,300°F R_LE = 0.5 in.," "**6,400°F R_N = 0.5 in."), with "Upper Surface" and "Lower Surface" labels; caption: "Figure 18. FDL-7C/D, Model 176 Entry Temperature Distribution. Upper-surface heating is minimized by cross-section geometry." Figure 19 pairs a black-and-white thermographic phosphor photo of the model with a contour map of local-to-reference heating; caption: "Figure 19. Even at Mach 12, Embedded Vortices in the Boundary Layer Alter the Local Heat Transfer."
